::: {.callout-note title="Human Evidence Is Unavailable"}
The checked-in state contains no participant data and cannot authorize
participant collection. A future study requires externally governed ethics,
privacy, consent, data-license, device-risk, calibration, stopping-rule, and
independent-release records. The participant-held-out analysis plan, exclusion
rules, power inputs, and multiplicity families must be registered before
unblinding. Passing software or synthetic-fixture tests is not a human release
decision.
:::
